messages.subject: how to delet a marker
parts:
Dear Karl:
I got a new map after I used the  "est.map". After I check the new map, I want to delet the frist marker in the chr2 of new map using the "drop.markers". After I done， I found the marker I delected was in  the original map, not in the new map. When I tried the  again, It showed "Input should have class "cross"". When I used “ pull.map(**,1)”， I still got the markers and distance of the old map.  If I should rename the new map?  How I can get the detail on new map?
I'm sorry to write the letter. 
Thanks and have a good day!
LInda

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: how to delet a marker
parts:
To view the map, you can just type it's name, and the whole thing will print out.

Or, assuming it's called "newmap", type

 newmap[[2]]

to view just the second chromosome.

To delete the first marker on the second chromosome, type

 newmap[[2]] <- newmap[[2]][-1]

karl
